'''SE-4-LQ3''' was an [[SE4 servant droid]] serving aboard the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'', working in the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] belly cargo hold. Along with [[R-97]], SE-4-LQ3 discovered the [[Variant|bacterial mutation]] that destroyed the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette's]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] stores.
